artifacts.command:
[".venv/bin/python", "-c", "import json,unicodedata
from pathlib import Path
from tiny_perceptron.natural_concepts import edit_distance
r=Path('docs/natural-assistant/evidence/v4-runtime/evaluate-37221188153/blind-review')
t=json.loads((r/'transcripts.json').read_text())
a=[x for x in t if x['source']=='aishell1-human-read-questions-v4']
n=lambda s: ''.join(unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',s).split())
print('AISHELL raw',sum(edit_distance(x['reference_transcript'],x['transcript']) for x in a),sum(len(x['reference_transcript']) for x in a))
print('AISHELL normalized',sum(edit_distance(n(x['reference_transcript']),n(x['transcript'])) for x in a),sum(len(n(x['reference_transcript'])) for x in a))
g=json.loads((r/'generations-base.json').read_text())
print('scene distinct images',len({x['image'] for x in g if x['task']=='scene'}))
print('paired ids',len({x['id'] for x in g if x['task'] in {'typed_chat','speech_chat'}}))
print('same source users',all(next(x['user'] for x in g if x['task']=='typed_chat' and x['id']==v['id'])==next(x['user'] for x in g if x['task']=='speech_chat' and x['id']==v['id']) for v in a))"]

["python", "-c", "from hashlib import sha256
expected=b'base A, adapter B'
received=b'base A, adapter C'
print('期待內容指紋',sha256(expected).hexdigest()[:12])
print('收到內容指紋',sha256(received).hexdigest()[:12])
print('內容符合清單',sha256(expected).digest()==sha256(received).digest())
print('完整digestbytes',sha256(expected).digest_size)"]
